edges.rationale: The TCP section presents TCPClient.py and TCPServer.py as implementations of the running uppercase-conversion example, so the example's workflow (client sends a line, server modifies it, server must be running first) must be understood before studying the TCP code.
The UDP section presents UDPClient.py and UDPServer.py as implementations of the same running uppercase-conversion example, so the example's workflow must be understood before studying the UDP code.

edges.dependent: Comparing TCP and UDP Socket Programs
edges.rationale: The side-by-side comparison requires knowledge of TCP's connection setup, welcome vs. connection sockets, and byte-stream model to contrast them against UDP.

edges.dependent: Comparing TCP and UDP Socket Programs
edges.rationale: The side-by-side comparison requires knowledge of UDP's connectionless sendto()/recvfrom() operation and per-packet addressing to contrast them against TCP.

edges.dependent: Choosing a Transport Protocol and Port Numbers
edges.rationale: Deciding whether an application runs over TCP requires understanding TCP's connection-oriented, reliable byte-stream characteristics covered in the TCP programming section.

edges.dependent: Choosing a Transport Protocol and Port Numbers
edges.rationale: Deciding whether an application runs over UDP requires understanding UDP's connectionless, no-delivery-guarantee characteristics covered in the UDP programming section.
